tools.name: verifier_engine
tools.description: Verifies legal citations and claims in a document. Returns a list of claims with verdicts (verified/unverified/fabricated/unknown), sources (ISAP/EUR-Lex/SAOS URL + fetched_at), an overall verdict and reasoning. Runs under the signed-in user's permissions.

documentContent.description: Full text of the document to verify (plain text or markdown).

documentName.description: Working name shown next to the case (content is not stored).

caseId.description: LEGAION case id. If given, the verification result (without document content) is attached to the case.

outputLanguage.description: Language of reasoning in the response (default: pl).

tools.name: deep_xray
tools.description: Risk audit of a document (same engine as the LEGAION panel). Returns risks by level (critical/high/medium/low), clauses with status, recommendations and a numeric score. Mode 'klauzule_abuzywne' adds matches against the UOKiK register of abusive clauses with entry number, URL and fetch timestamp; without a confirmed fetch the status stays 'unconfirmed'.

documentContent.description: Full text of the document to analyse (plain text or markdown).

analysisMode.description: 'standard' = full risk audit; 'klauzule_abuzywne' = audit + UOKiK register check.

tools.name: list_cases
tools.description: List the signed-in user's LEGAION cases. Optionally filter by status. Runs under the user's row-level permissions.

tools.name: list_clients
tools.description: List the signed-in user's LEGAION clients (company, contact person, email). Runs under the user's row-level permissions.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return the signed-in LEGAION user's id, email and OAuth client id. Use to verify connectivity.
